Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods. The segment operations repeat their conventions: CreateValidators (MaxCountValidator over Constants.MaxAllowedSegments, DomainAddressValidator, or the change-medium-type triple), the CreateCouplerValidator factory that all four move/copy operations share, and the undo/redo pair that runs the move and then SecurityValidatorBase.Undo/Redo.
Method.state machine: CopySegmentOperation's iterator is <GetDevicesWithAddresses>d__38, so that row carries the original name.
Method.addresses: SegmentValidation.GetCouplingDirection uses CouplerCheck.IsCoupler with the allowed medium types; ClearDeviceAddresses clears the individual address and every additional address; ChangeDomainAddressOperation.SetDomainAddress remembers the old value before applying the new one and ResetMediumConfigLoadedFlags clears the flag on every device.
